data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: skip-review-check.sh consumes dso.workflow without legacy enforcement.strategy key (RED phase)
- DD5: TDD RED phase

## What to Change
Modify `tests/scripts/test-skip-review-check.sh` (the test that covers the enforcement.strategy=ci short-circuit):

Current test (`test_skip_review_check_strategy_ci_bypasses_classification`):
- Relies on the project's actual dso-config.conf having `enforcement.strategy=ci` to trigger short-circuit
- Uses `DSO_FORCE_LOCAL_REVIEW=1` to suppress it in other tests

New test (`test_skip_review_check_dso_workflow_ci_pr_bypasses_classification`):
- Injects a fixture config with `dso.workflow=ci-pr` via WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE
- Asserts exit 0 (SKIP=true) when workflow=ci-pr, regardless of file classification
- Adds test for `dso.workflow=local` fixture: should NOT short-circuit (review required for reviewable files)
- Remove the `enforcement.strategy=ci` reliance; use WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE for isolation

These tests MUST FAIL before Task 12 (skip-review-check.sh still reads enforcement.strategy).

## Test Approach (Given / When / Then)
- Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE with `dso.workflow=ci-pr`, reviewable file (app/src/main.py) on stdin
- When: bash skip-review-check.sh
- Then: exit 0 (SKIP=true — CI is source of truth, local review skipped)

- Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE with `dso.workflow=local`, reviewable file on stdin
- When: bash skip-review-check.sh
- Then: exit 1 (SKIP=false — local mode, review required)

## .test-index RED Marker Requirement
Update .test-index for `plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh`:
Add RED markers for new test function names.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — suite with RED markers
  Verify: bash -c 'grep "\[test_skip_review_check_dso_workflow_ci_pr" .test-index && echo "RED marker present"'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Test file contains dso.workflow-based short-circuit test
  Verify: grep -q 'dso.workflow\|dso_workflow' tests/scripts/test-skip-review-check.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_skip_review_check_dso_workflow_ci_pr' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: UPDATE test: assert skip-review-check.sh short-circuits on dso.workflow=ci-pr instead of enforcement.strategy=ci
